# Task P1-08: Quality definitions, quality profiles and library API

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** P1-01 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
The seeded qualities can be listed, quality profiles can be created, edited and deleted with validation, and libraries can be listed and edited (layout, naming template, album policy), through *arr-style endpoints the Settings UI (P1-12) will use. Business rules live in Core services; controllers only map.

## Deliverables
Core (namespace `Compilarr.Core.Profiles`, services registered **scoped** in `AddCompilarrCore`, EF queries only here):
1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Profiles/QualityDefinitionService.cs` — `IQualityDefinitionService.GetAllAsync(ct)` → all `Quality` rows ordered by id (read with `AsNoTracking`).
2. `src/Compilarr.Core/Profiles/QualityProfileService.cs` — `IQualityProfileService`: `GetAllAsync`, `GetAsync(id)` (null if missing), `AddAsync(QualityProfile)`, `UpdateAsync(QualityProfile)`, `DeleteAsync(id)`. Validation before every write returns/throws a `ProfileValidationException` (new, carries a list of `(string Property, string Message)`):
   - `Name` non-empty, ≤ 100 chars, unique (case-insensitive) among profiles;
   - every seeded quality id (`quality` table) appears **exactly once** across `Items`, and no unknown id appears;
   - at least one item is allowed; `CutoffQualityId` is in an allowed item;
   - `MinScore` 0–1000; `DurationToleranceMs` 0–60000.
   - Delete: `ProfileInUseException` when any `song` uses it or it is the last profile; unknown id → returns false.
3. `src/Compilarr.Core/Profiles/LibraryService.cs` — `ILibraryService`: `GetAllAsync`, `GetAsync(id)`, `GetDefaultAsync()`, `UpdateAsync(Library)`. Validation (same exception type): `Name` non-empty, unique; `RootPath` absolute (starts with `/`, or a Windows drive root like `D:\` for development); `NamingTemplate` non-empty and contains `{Track Title}`; `MinTracksPerRealAlbum` 1–10; `SidecarOptions` is valid JSON. Setting `IsDefault = true` clears it on every other library in the same transaction; clearing it on the only default library is a validation error.

API (namespace `Compilarr.Api.Profiles`), `[ApiController]`, JSON, RFC 7807 errors (`ValidationProblem` with the property → messages dictionary for validation, `Problem(statusCode: 409)` for in-use, 404 for unknown ids):
4. `src/Compilarr.Api/Profiles/QualityDefinitionController.cs` — `GET /api/v1/qualitydefinition` → `[{ id, name, group, rank, codec, lossless, minBitrate, maxBitrate, bitDepth }]`.
5. `src/Compilarr.Api/Profiles/QualityProfileController.cs` + `QualityProfileResource.cs` — `GET /api/v1/qualityprofile`, `GET /api/v1/qualityprofile/{id}`, `POST` (201 + Location), `PUT /api/v1/qualityprofile/{id}` (body id must match or be 0), `DELETE /api/v1/qualityprofile/{id}` (200/404/409). Resource: `{ id, name, upgradeAllowed, cutoff, minScore, durationToleranceMs, items: [{ name, qualities: [{ id, name }], allowed }] }` (`cutoff` is the quality id; `items` worst → best; on input only `qualities[].id` is read).
6. `src/Compilarr.Api/Profiles/LibraryController.cs` + `LibraryResource.cs` — `GET /api/v1/library`, `GET /api/v1/library/{id}`, `PUT /api/v1/library/{id}`. Resource: `{ id, name, rootPath, layout, namingTemplate, sidecarOptions (JSON object), albumPolicy, minTracksPerRealAlbum, plexSectionId, isDefault }`; enums as camelCase strings (`plexamp`, `fewestAlbums`, `artistAlbum`) — the API's `JsonStringEnumConverter(JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase)` already does this.
7. `docs/api/openapi.json` regenerated (`COMPILARR_UPDATE_OPENAPI=1 dotnet test --filter OpenApiSnapshot`).
8. Tests: `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Profiles/QualityProfileServiceTests.cs`, `LibraryServiceTests.cs` (real SQLite via `SqliteTestDatabase`, migrated so the seeds exist); `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/QualityProfileApiTests.cs`, `LibraryApiTests.cs` (via `CompilarrAppFactory`).

- `src/Compilarr.Core/Profiles/**`, `src/Compilarr.Core/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs`
- `src/Compilarr.Api/Profiles/**`, `docs/api/openapi.json`
- `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Profiles/**`, `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/QualityProfileApiTests.cs`, `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/LibraryApiTests.cs`

- `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/Quality.cs`, `Library.cs`, `SeedData.cs`, `DomainEnums.cs` (P1-01)

## Constraints
- No new packages. Controllers contain no EF code. Every endpoint requires the API key (the default policy already does this — do not add `[AllowAnonymous]`).
- Services are scoped (they use the scoped `CompilarrDbContext`).

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. `GET /api/v1/qualitydefinition` → 43 entries, id 28 is `OPUS-160` in group "Mid lossy"; without a key → 401.
3. `GET /api/v1/qualityprofile` → "Standard 320" (cutoff 29) and "Lossless" (cutoff 36); the Standard 320 item containing 29 also contains 25 (AAC-256).
4. `POST` a copy of Standard 320 named "Test" → 201; `PUT` it with cutoff 26 (Vorbis Q7, not allowed) → 400 whose errors name `cutoff`; `PUT` with quality 29 listed twice → 400; with quality 43 missing → 400; `POST` a second "test" (case) → 400; `DELETE` → 200, then `GET` → 404.
5. `DELETE` of a profile used by a song → 409 (insert a song directly through the DbContext in the test); deleting the last remaining profile → 409.
6. `GET /api/v1/library` → the default "Music" library (`layout` `plexamp`, `albumPolicy` `fewestAlbums`); `PUT` with `minTracksPerRealAlbum` 3 and policy `singlesOnly` → 200 and persisted; `PUT` with an empty naming template → 400; `PUT` with `isDefault` false on the only library → 400.
7. The OpenAPI snapshot test passes with the regenerated `docs/api/openapi.json`.

## Out of scope
- Creating/deleting libraries, source profiles, the Settings UI (P1-12).
